about: The v9 IA error budget (analysis/roman_dchi2/v9), the correlated residual prior and Fisher method of the lssty1xdesi notes applied to the IA spectra: a random fractional error delta(X, z_s, k_i) of P_GI and P_II at 31 nodes in ln k (0.01 to 10 h/Mpc, splined) and the 13 FLAMINGO snapshots, Gaussian with rms sigma and correlation exp(-|ln k_i - ln k_j|/ell) exp(-|z_s - z_t|/L_z) (L_z = inf: the same error at every z), GI and II independent unless stated. The shifts of Omega_m and S8 follow from 1586 exact cosmolike responses (one per ln k tent and snapshot) and the Fisher matrix of the truth-as-model (Omega_m, A_s, A, eta free). sigma_max: the rms at which the rms shift of the limiting parameter reaches 0.3 of its error (eta = sqrt(1 + 0.3^2)); sigma_95: the rms at which 95% of errors keep both shifts below 0.3 sigma (the v8 criterion). 1 = no limit within 100%. example1_cov. The band: the error of one spectrum X confined to one k range around k_c (a Gaussian window of width 0.3 in ln k, every z), sigma_max[truth][cut][X][L_z] for ell = 1 (and ell = 0.3, 3 under sigma_max_ell), sigma_95[cut][X][L_z] the same with the 95% criterion. errors[cut][model][X]: P^model/P^truth - 1 at the core snapshots (z_core) on k_dense, each model fitted at the fiducial cosmology (IA parameters only) with the same cut (v8/fid_fits.py). (ia_budget.py, section band.)
